name: Global Properties
description: Reuse properties across collections. Add any property from anywhere in the workspace to any other collection, or save a whole set as a template and apply it in a couple of clicks. Copies the full definition: type, icon, multi-value, choice options and their colours, number format, and which collection a linked-record property points at. It also decides what new records start with: values inherited from the record you created them inside, and fixed defaults per field. Adding is purely additive and skips any property whose name the target already uses; the one thing it can change is the order you place the new fields in.
